title: SHOPPINGCOMP: ARE LLMS REALLY READY FOR YOUR SHOPPING CART?

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting cross-judge comparisons using three independent LLM judges (Gemini-2.5-Pro, Deepseek-v3.2, and GPT-5) to determine if LLM-based evaluators assign disproportionately higher scores to outputs generated by models from their own family.
